messages:
anna: Quick async OKR check — please drop a 1-line update per milestone you own (shipped / slipped, blocker if any, next step). Aim: EOD PST. Keep it terse, I will compile.
maya: Runtime autoscale (dedicated pool) — shipped canary, observing p99 latency regressions. Likely batching bug introduced in v2. Next: roll back to previous batching config + hotfix PR tomorrow. CR ping: @ryan
ryan: I reproduced the p99 locally with the sample trace. cause looks like batching window miscalc. preparing small fix in `scheduler.go`. will post PR in ~2h.
liam: Embeddings pipeline — slipped. Model quantization took longer than expected and surfaced a perf regression in cold starts. Blocker: infra quota for extra nodes. Next: escalate to infra, aim soft-launch next Wed.
jamal: SDK + docs — partial ship (JS SDK updated). Missing python examples and private deploy guide. Next: finishing python examples by Thu, will open PR with examples and snippets.
ess: deploy-bot: Canary deployment to dedicated pool completed at 1759994300 :rocket:
sophia: Suggestion: add automatic fallback routing to smaller quantized model for latency spikes. I can own the rollout + metric gates; plan to canary rule Fri 09:00 PST.
anna: Thanks — owners noted: @maya (runtime), @liam (embeddings), @jamal (docs), @sophia (fallbacks). If blocked, add "blocked" label in tracker and ping here. CR pings: Maya -> @ryan, Liam -> @eng-infra.
ryan: PR posted: https://git.internal/r/2987 — tiny change in batching calc. @maya can you validate on canary while I run unit/regressions?
maya: validating now on canary + staging. preliminary looks good, no p99 blips after patch. will merge after one more +1. :thumbsup:
liam: INF ticket INF-4523 opened for node quota, set P1. @eng-infra can you confirm ETA for provisioning?
eng-infra: Noted, budget approved. Provisioning scheduled for Mon morning, should unblock LIAM's soft-launch.
jamal: Docs PR linked: https://git.internal/docs/1234 — includes VPC + on-prem examples. Feedback welcome; will iterate.
sophia: Fallback rule PR up, running regression tests. Canary planned for Fri 09:00 PST with metric gate on p95 and error-rate.
anna: Perfect — I'll compile a short exec summary and post to #product-exec by EOD. Thanks for the quick turn. If anything changes, update this thread. :tada:
